name: Camping 101: Alchemy
summary: Kray in Thunder Bluff can teach you to craft a Mana Well for your alchemist's camp. The well draws healers and spellcasters seeking refreshment.

sections.title: A Well for Camp
sections.body: An alchemist can learn to craft a Mana Well from Kray in Thunder Bluff. You have shown proficiency in your skill, and Kray can teach you this camping craft. Healers and spellcasters will come for a refreshing taste. To set up camp in the wilderness, you also need a campfire, which a cook can teach you to make.

faq.q: Who teaches me to craft a Mana Well?
faq.answer: Kray in Thunder Bluff can teach you to craft a Mana Well once you have shown proficiency in alchemy.

faq.q: What is a Mana Well for?
faq.answer: A Mana Well is a camping craft for alchemists. Healers and spellcasters come to it for refreshment.

faq.q: Where do I learn this camping craft?
faq.answer: You speak with Kray in Thunder Bluff to learn the Mana Well craft.

faq.q: What else do I need to set up camp?
faq.answer: A camp needs a campfire before it can be set up. A cook can teach you to make one.

faq.q: Can I test the Mana Well in town?
faq.answer: The completion instructions say most folk do not care for camps in the center of town, so you need to head into the wilderness to test it.
